Along with having less energy, how has your mood been lately—have you been feeling down, sad, or empty?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I feel sad or... or empty. It's not like that. I hope that's okay to say. I just... I feel fine, mostly. Just a little tired, I guess. I'm not crying all the time or anything like that. I know people probably think I am because I'm in my room so much, but I'm really not. I just... I don't feel much of anything, honestly. Is that... is that what you meant? I'm sorry if I'm not answering this right.
Have you ever heard voices, sounds, or whispering when no one else was around?

Um, no... no, I haven't. I mean, I don't think so. I haven't heard any voices or whispering or anything like that. I promise I haven't. 

I hope it's okay that I say no to that. I know my mom is worried about me, and I know I've been acting a little different lately, but I'm definitely not hearing things. Is it... is it alright that I haven't? I just really want to make sure I'm answering everything right for you.
About how long has it been since you started having this low energy and difficulty doing your usual activities?

Um, well... I guess it's actually been kind of a long time. I'm really sorry, I know I probably should have asked for help sooner. I just didn't want to make a big fuss or be a bother to my mom. 

But, um... I think it started back when I began a community-college program. That was about... maybe two years and two months ago? Give or take a little bit?
